Heritage 25 Mar 2025

VICTORIAS CITY’S SIDLAK SANG KADALAG-AN DANCERS WIN GRAND SLAM CHAMPION IN THE BEST FESTIVAL OF DANCES COMPETION AT THE 2025 PANAAD SA NEGROS FESTIVAL

Congratulations to our very own Kadalag-an Festival Dancers for bagging the grand slam champion, winning in the best of Festival Dances at the Panaad sa Negros Festival held on March 24, 2025. This is the 3rd year in a row victory for Victorias City under the leadership of Mayor Javier Miguel L. Benitez.

The appearance of St. Casimiro alongside the Jesuit missionaries is a first. I am glad they are featured, as his image, along with the Jesuits, represents a very important historical event and, in general, a significant cultural heritage for Victorias.

In 1728, the Jesuits established the foranía or the so-called ecclesiastical jurisdiction of the parish of Tukgagwan, with St. Casimiro as the patron saint. This foranía covered the area from the northern bank of the Matab-ang River in Talisay City all the way to the northern bank of the Tanjay River, with EB Magalona originally known as tue village of Tukgagwan before becoming known as the town of Saravia as the center of Tukgagwan. The foranía also encompassed Victorias, wjich played a significant role in the region’s religious and cultural development. Their hermitage was located in Sum-ag.

In the folklore of Victorias, St. Casimiro is depicted as the one who accompanied the Lady of Victory in saving the townspeople from attacking marauders. The image in the possession of the Silava-Flores family in Barangay 3 is believed to be the original one brought by the Jesuits in 1728.

to Ricky Lapidante, the choreographer, you made Victorias so proud tonight. You are a true gem, and an icon of Festival Dances. As a friend, I cannot be happier. You are tested and proven, over and over again. Thank you for selflessly sharing your talent to the world. I am so proud of you.

To Mayor Javier Miguel L. Benitez, thank you for making all of these possible with your all out support, encouragements and determination to win the championship prize f9r 3 consecutive years, making Victorias, the grandslam winner this year. You made us so proud to be called Victoriasanons.

This is not just an honor in this competition, it is a triumph for the city of Victorias, its culture, history, heritage and people. Tonight, we made history, we made a legacy. VICTORIAS IS INDEED, VICTORIOUS!

Kudos to one and all!

GOD BLESS US!

GOD BLESS VICTORIAS!
